checks.description: Every record in the sample ledger validates against signet-schema.json (cwi-signet/v1): required keys present, assertion_id in vocabulary, timestamp ISO-8601 UTC, record_hash 64-hex, evidence non-empty with source + date. The genesis block is honestly labeled (prev_hash GENESIS, claim states it is the ledger opening). Brand rule: the official CWI logo is present on every shipped visual asset (index.html, announce.html) — no page renders without the badge.

Every record's record_hash recomputes from its body; every prev_hash matches the previous record's record_hash; any single-byte mutation of any record breaks verification (seal mismatch, link mismatch, or both). Verification runs offline with stdlib-only seal.py — no service, no key.

Sample assertions assert only verified CWI facts: Zooted Zone produced by Kokurcho (CWI Medium articles); Diabolique recorded at Cue Recording Studio, Arlington VA (owner-confirmed 2026-09-15); New Rap Hits #21/#30/#31 (verified 2026-09-15). No unverified wins (Flow 'No Label Needed', DJ 6Rings 'It's Goin', WATCH THA GAP) appear as claims anywhere. No deny-list language.

DEFAULT_CONFIG + optional config.json override flow works: a config.json with orgName/productName/colors overrides the CWI defaults and produces a branded build with no unreplaced tokens. The sealer itself is org-agnostic — any agent name seals.

EQUIP / CONFIGURE / APPLY steps are copy-paste operable: every URL referenced (sealer, sample ledger, schema, card, page, compass hub, contact) is live, and the APPLY block is a valid press-and-verify snippet.

evidence.assertion-schema-conformance: test.py gate 1 validates all 4 sample records against the schema contract; genesis block labeled honestly with prev_hash GENESIS
evidence.chain-integrity: test.py gate 2 recomputes all seals + links; gate 3 mutates one byte and confirms verification fails
evidence.give-block-operability: give-block.md EQUIP/CONFIGURE/APPLY reference sealer, sample ledger, schema, item-card, page, compass hub, hp@cumulativeweb.com
evidence.verified-facts-integrity: gate 1 asserts the exact verified-fact strings; deny-list scan clean across shipped files
evidence.white-label-config: gate 4 builds a temp config.json override through build.py and confirms overrides land with no leftover tokens

self_evaluation.run: automated: signet/test.py gate 4 evaluates the product against this rubric
